# bif-app v0.1.0 — Windows portable

Stable promotion of **v0.1.0-alpha.4**, with no functional changes. The application
version is updated to 0.1.0 and the UI, gateway and desktop host are rebuilt from
the same release commit.

Windows x64 portable using your existing Microsoft WebView2 runtime. Download
`bif-app-windows-x64-portable.zip`, extract all files, then run `bif-app.exe`.
No installer or bundled WebView2 runtime is included.

## Included

- Original Bifrost HTTP gateway and OSS UI in a Tauri desktop shell.
- Tray, single instance, owned sidecar lifecycle and optional start at login.
- Local data and Windows Credential Manager encryption-key storage.
- Desktop network settings with validated custom IP/localhost and port selection.
- Audited Enterprise-only placeholder entries and promotions hidden in desktop
  builds; OSS functionality and ordinary server builds remain unchanged.

## Upgrade

Use **Quit** in the old application's tray menu, extract the new ZIP into a new
folder, and launch `bif-app.exe`. Keep its sidecar and accompanying files together.
Existing data, network settings and Credential Manager key are preserved.

Default API: `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1`. **Copy API Base URL** in the tray gives
the actual endpoint when a custom address or another port is configured.

## Validation

This version-only promotion uses a fresh Windows release build and extracted
portable-host smoke checks, plus package/source/version and SHA256 verification.
The full functionality suite is inherited from the successful
[alpha.4 Windows run](https://github.com/favefan/bif-app/actions/runs/36404694383):
10 UI cases, 14 Rust unit tests, 2 real gateway integration tests, Desktop Settings
WebView checks and an ordinary gateway build. These full suites were not rerun
for this promotion. No paid provider calls, new physical Windows 11 session or
new interactive tray-menu validation were performed. The portable is unsigned.

bif-app is an independent desktop wrapper based on the open-source Bifrost AI
Gateway by Maxim. Bifrost is developed by Maxim. Not affiliated with or endorsed
by Maxim. Upstream licenses and notices are included.
